headword: {心筋梗塞|しんきんこうそく}

definitions.explanation: A serious medical condition in which blood flow to the heart muscle is blocked, causing tissue damage. One of the leading causes of death worldwide.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{心筋梗塞|しんきんこうそく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{倒|たお}れた→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧。
examples.english: My father collapsed from a heart attack.

notes:
A medical compound of {心筋|しんきん} (cardiac muscle, myocardium) + ⟦{梗塞|こうそく}→梗塞：24638_kousoku⟧ (infarction, blockage). A critical medical term that Japanese learners may encounter in news, health discussions, and daily life.
